verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS process service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only the hosted service: the process service, company records and MCP endpoint all run at api.ultrametric.ai and require login. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment. A few CLI commands (understand, assess, local schema validation) run offline, but they are client-side pieces, not the core product running on your own infrastructure, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
